# Bottom Bar

```tsx
import { BottomBar, BottomBarItem } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

The main navigation of a mobile screen: 2 to 4 destinations in a floating pill. Mirrors the Figma Bottom Bar (Items=2 / 3 / 4) and its .Bottom Bar Button (State: Default / Pressed / Active / Disabled + Focus, Show Badge). `BottomBar` only draws the bar; pin it to the bottom of the screen where it's used. Each `BottomBarItem` is a `<button>`, or a link through `render`.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<StoryBottomBar
  {...args}
  onSelect={(index) => updateArgs({ activeItem: index })}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Bottom Bar: a Background/Surface pill with Shadow/Large and 8px padding, holding 2, 3 or 4 .Bottom Bar Button items side by side (Figma Items=2 / 3 / 4). It only draws the bar: pin it to the bottom of the screen where it's used.

Parts:
- `BottomBarItem`: One destination of the Bottom Bar. Renders a `<button>`; pass `render` (an `<a>` or a Next.js `<Link>`) to navigate instead.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`BottomBarItemProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `IconSvgElement` | Figma Icon: any Hugeicons icon, 24px. |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Label: Label/X-Small, cut with an ellipsis past one line. |
| `active?` | `boolean` | Figma State=Active: the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`). |
| `disabled?` | `boolean` | Figma State=Disabled. |
| `badge?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Badge: the count in an Accent Badge on the top right. Hidden while disabled, as in Figma. |

## Types

`BottomBarItemProps`

## Rules

- Import `BottomBar` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
